chapters.title: Full Text
chapters.summary:
Every investor has a dream that she should create a portfolio of stocks, which should generate wealth for
her. The portfolio should support her
in the hard work to sustain and improve the financial position of her family, her lifestyle and if possible
give her an opportunity to retire early and fulfil all her dreams: travel, adventure and doing things she is
passionate 	about. I 	have 	the 	same 	dreams 	and 	desire 	that 	my 	stock 	portfolio should 	generate 	sufficient
